environment.note: wave-10 B12 IN-MEMORY control matrix; not durable recovery (see b13)

scope: in-process only; durable recovery is b13; native control NOT_TESTED

cases.title: a stop issued before the writer exists is still delivered once
detail: both stops resolved (confirmed/confirmed) over 1 physical command(s)

cases.title: an answer keeps the native binding and the attempt identity
detail: every answer carries the same attempt and epoch, so it cannot be applied to another attempt

cases.title: a steer of different content gets a different command identity
detail: two different steers produced distinct command identities

cases.title: a same-process re-instantiation does not begin again (NOT durable recovery)
detail: the reconnect issued no additional begin (1 total)

cases.title: a proof bound to the old attempt does not release a new one
detail: the old proof names only its own attempt, so it cannot be read as releasing a new one

cases.title: an unproven stop never reads as a clean stop
detail: three repeated stops kept the writer unresolved instead of decaying to stopped

cases.title: these windows are controlled evidence and say so
detail: real vendor stop/answer/steer, disconnect/reconnect and unknown-send reconciliation remain untested; this matrix is controlled evidence only

evidence.classification: controlled (real supervisor, real proof transport, fake runner)
